records.note: No prison-housing data found for trans people in Western Sahara. A Wikipedia full-text search for Western Sahara + transgender prison placement returned no relevant results, and candidate fetches of HRW World Report 2024 (Western Sahara chapter URL) and the Amnesty Morocco/Western Sahara report page returned only client-side navigation shells with no chapter content. The territory is administered by Morocco, has no legal gender recognition and no documented policy, special unit, or case law on where trans prisoners are housed (birth-sex vs identity placement); no solitary/segregation practice specific to trans detainees is recorded in any accessible source.

No prison-housing data found for trans prisoners in The Gambia. A Wikipedia full-text search for Gambia transgender prisoner/women's prison returned only generic LGBTQ-rights-by-country articles with no placement content, and candidate fetches of the Amnesty Gambia report page and HRW World Report 2024 Gambia chapter URL returned JS shells (HRW chapter content is client-side rendered and did not download). No documented rule on birth-sex vs identity placement, no special units, no solitary/segregation practice and no reported trans-prisoner case were found; the strongest available national sources (UK Home Office CPIN GMB SOGI v3.0 Feb 2023; HRW 'State of Fear' 2015, already cited in this batch) cover general harsh prison conditions and police abuse of LGBT people but contain no trans-specific placement data.
